fusions.name: Unbending Rule
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 14 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Frozen Proclamation
fusions.desc: A cone 5 tiles long that deals 28 damage to everything in it, ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Grey Mantle
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 6% while it holds.

fusions.name: Cast Crown
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12% at all times.
